objective: Turn the M122 held-out K4 source-fold opportunity into a standalone block-phased RTL module with lossless canonical select-and-clear, generic signed-INT8 polarity support, one shared 1536-byte logical weight cache, and an exact commercial-VCS numeric miter.

heldout_cycle_dse.scope: cycle-simulator projection only; neither figure is measured by this standalone RTL test

motivation.width_repair: four independently negated signed-INT8 sources can sum to +512, so the generic K4 fold is signed11 rather than signed10

architecture.selection: canonical lowest-four set bits followed by lossless select-and-clear
architecture.polarity: independent per selected source before summation
architecture.arithmetic: exact signed addition; no saturation and no rounding
architecture.block_phase: a block change invalidates the prior cache identity; a row is accepted only after every referenced source vector is valid for the resident block

expected_pass_line: PASS M125 block-phased K4 row fold VCS fills=51 rows=66 row_done=66 updates=155 selected_sources=528 numeric_lane_checks=14880 full_k4_updates=105 tail_updates=50 same_row_update_pairs=64 update_stalls=47 negated_minus128_contributions=20 plus512_checks=1 cache_bytes=1536 resident_blocks=1 logical_read_bits_per_update=3072 generic_fold_bits=11 accumulator_delta_bits=19 canonical_select_clear=true fixed8_service_island_projection=3.1725369008459166 projection_only=true m123_integrated=false foundry_weight_macro=false physical_speedup=false system_speedup=false headline=false
paper_safe_statement: Commercial VCS verifies a block-phased K4 row-fold module that losslessly consumes 528 selected source contributions in 155 accepted updates across 66 directed rows, including stalls, tails, consecutive updates to the same row, and the generic +512 signed11 boundary. The shared 1536-byte cache remains behavioral; the held-out 3.17x fixed8 service-island figure is a separate cycle-simulator projection, not an RTL or system-speed measurement.
prohibited_claims: Do not describe the behavioral 1536-byte register cache as a foundry SRAM macro.
Do not claim that M125 has been integrated with or committed through the M123 accumulator.
Do not turn the 3.1725369008459166 fixed8 service-island projection or the 1.251266 K4-vs-K1 projection into physical or system speedup.
Do not claim macro-inclusive PPA, power, energy, FPS or end-to-end scheduling from this functional VCS result.
